title: EventBus listener registry snapshot isolation contract

contract.snapshot_isolation: EventBus.emit() delivers to a snapshot of the listener registry captured before callback execution
contract.mid_emit_registration: A listener registered during an emit is not delivered the event currently in progress
contract.mid_emit_unregistration: A listener unregistered during an emit remains eligible for delivery from the current snapshot
contract.next_emit_registry: Registry mutations during one emit take effect for subsequent emits
contract.delivery_order: Current snapshot delivery preserves listener registration order
contract.registry_integrity: Listener registry remains structurally consistent after mid-emit mutations
contract.permission_enforcement: Listener registration and removal continue to require the events permission
